passage.title: Account of Stanley's arrest
paras: Stanley Yelnats was walking home from school when the sneakers fell from the sky. They hit him on the head. He picked them up and started to run, because he wanted to tell his father what had happened.
A police car pulled up beside him. Two officers stopped Stanley and asked where he had got the sneakers. Stanley told them the truth, but they did not believe him.
They soon discovered that the sneakers belonged to Clyde Livingston, a famous baseball player, who had given them to a shelter for homeless children.
The police arrested Stanley and drove him to the station. A judge later found him guilty and gave him a choice: jail, or Camp Green Lake.
passage.source: Teacher-written for TGA, retelling events from Louis Sachar's Holes in our own words.
